work.title: Prepare the tutoring-centre landing page
work.outcome:
A reviewed landing page that explains the tutoring-centre offer and gives prospective customers one clear next step.

Preserve the approved offer, audience and claims. Build the responsive page in the existing site. Keep the enquiry action keyboard accessible. Verify the page at desktop and narrow widths. Record the exact source revision and link the native review target. Do not publish or contact customers; those remain separate owner-authority decisions.
work.resolution: The landing page is complete and passed desktop, narrow-screen and keyboard checks. It remains private until the owner makes a separate publishing decision.
work.expected_artifact: A reviewable landing page and its browser-check report.

artifacts.note: The private landing page the owner can inspect before any publishing decision.

items.title: Confirm the company identity with the email provider
